reasons.reason: The Japanese FM profile is one of the two profiles only a run over real cartridges adds (the fixtures cover it already), so one judged cartridge row with fm on shows that the owner's library run reached the ledger; a fail still counts, because it shows the profile ran.

The PAL profile is the other profile only a run over real cartridges adds, so one judged cartridge row with tv pal shows that the owner's library run reached the ledger; a fail still counts, because it shows the profile ran.

Twenty distinct cartridge images with a judged pass row show that a real library run reached the ledger; one image with a default and a PAL pass row counts once, and they are not a pass rate. Twenty is about 1.4 percent of 1,444 images and over twice the nine fixture passes, so fixtures plus a token run cannot reach it; agents cannot see the library's size, so any other number would be a guess, and the floor is one reviewed reasons edit away from a change.
Today's measured value of the own fixtures: two fixture rows are judged with the Japanese FM unit on (fm_sweep and psg_sweep); a floor under it keeps the FM profile from silently losing its proof.
